problem: Results are re-sorted by weight, largest first, so share i no longer corresponds to input weight i and money goes to the wrong recipient without any error (e.g. allocate('10', [1, 3]) returns [7.50, 2.50] instead of [2.50, 7.50]); string weights are also sorted as text, not as numbers.

The sort compares raw weight values, so mixing weight types that are still accepted (int with str, Decimal with str) raises TypeError where main returned a valid allocation (e.g. allocate('10', ['1', 2])).
The production allocate now delegates to reference_impl, a copy kept for comparison, so edits to that copy silently change production behavior and it can no longer serve as an independent oracle.
No tests exist; a single case with unsorted, unequal weights such as [1, 3] -> [2.50, 7.50] would have caught the reordering regression.
The Fraction import (ruff F401) and the _to_decimal helper at line 6 are now unused leftovers from the rewrite.
